result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, 15.012)
    .extrude(15.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(8.0)
    .faces("<Z").edges("%LINE").chamfer(2.0)
)
show_object(result)

nodes.name: mcts1-refine
nodes.code:
import math
import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, 15.012)
    .extrude(15.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(8.0)
    .faces("<Z").edges("%LINE").chamfer(2.0, 2.0 * math.tan(math.radians(45.0)))
)
show_object(result)

nodes.name: mcts2-diversify
nodes.code:
import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, 15.012)
    .extrude(15.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(8.0)
    .edges(cq.selectors.BoxSelector((-20, -20, -0.001), (20, 20, 0.001)) & cq.selectors.TypeSelector("LINE"))
    .chamfer(2.0)
)
show_object(result)
